correctness.rationale: For a cycle, acyclic orientations are all 2^n−2 nonconstant cyclic edge choices; its incidence matrix is totally unimodular, so the normal-cone dual semigroup is saturated. The rank-one circuit has primitive signs on the k forward and n−k backward edges; its toric ideal is a single binomial product(a)−product(b), yielding entire affine charts. The Jacobian vanishes exactly with at least two zero coordinates in each block; these are (n−4)-planes, codimension three in dim n−1. Fixed-point count 2^n−2n−2 and Hilbert–Samuel order min(k,n−k) follow; normal toric hypersurface is Gorenstein. Independently checked orientation and singular fixed-count numerics for n=3..8. Full arbitrary-characteristic proof supplied by incidence and Jacobian, not experiments.
